rows.corpus_definition: to provide something that people need
rows.example_en: This company will supply parts for our factory.

rows.corpus_definition: to provide something that is needed or wanted
rows.example_en: They supply food to the local schools daily.

rows.corpus_definition: feeling shocked because something was unexpected
rows.example_en: I was surprised at how fast she learned.

rows.corpus_definition: feeling that something might be wrong or dishonest
rows.example_en: The police were suspicious of his strange behavior.

rows.corpus_definition: To use very bad or rude language when you are angry.
rows.example_en: Do not swear in front of the children.

rows.corpus_definition: to make a very serious promise; to use very bad language
rows.example_en: He swore he would never lie to her again.
The swift river carried the boat downstream quickly.

rows.corpus_definition: To change from one thing or action to another.
rows.example_en: We decided to switch our travel plans.

rows.corpus_definition: a long piece of serious music for a full orchestra
rows.example_en: The orchestra performed Beethoven's fifth symphony last night.

rows.corpus_definition: to return something to a store for a refund
rows.example_en: I need to take back these shoes tomorrow.

rows.corpus_definition: Naturally good at doing a specific activity.
rows.example_en: He is very talented at playing piano.

rows.corpus_definition: Money that you pay to the government.
rows.example_en: They raised the income tax again.

rows.corpus_definition: Money you must pay to the government.
rows.example_en: Everyone has to pay income tax.
